RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster raises legitimate concerns regarding unconscious bias and may breach internal recruitment policies requiring panel diversity. However, panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. The decision could reflect a genuine editorial priority for digital transformation or differences in interview performance.

Before formally alleging bias, follow up on your request for written feedback and request the selection criteria and scoring notes. Review your employer’s recruitment guidelines to see if panel diversity rules were violated. If the feedback is non-responsive, inconsistent with the job description, or points to procedural unfairness, consult your union or an employment specialist to determine whether to file a grievance.
